_comment: rootfs_bytes_max is the BLOCKING per-board content ceiling, not the frozen 4096M ext4 slot size. The universal 1500000000-byte placeholder is retired for RK3588 full-firmware adoption: both boards use 3500000000, x86 remains 1500000000. Budget review uses wet per-board measurements and stays below the frozen slot minus 536870912 bytes; actual populated-slot bavail and inode reserves are checked independently. Planning estimates authorize no artifact. See docs/bluetooth-firmware-closure.md. Keys beginning with '_' are metadata, not board entries.

_baked_binaries._comment: Non-apt binaries fetched + staged into the rootfs at build time (postinst-lib.sh), recorded here so the per-board rootfs_bytes_max headroom stays auditable. bytes = staged binary size measured 2026-07-02; all comfortably under the 1.5 GB ceiling. Metadata only — NOT a board entry (measure-size.sh ignores '_'-prefixed keys).

mediamtx.note: RTMP ingest gateway (Todo 14). Per-arch static Go binary; ~52 MiB (amd64) / ~59 MiB (arm64). The plan estimated ~30 MB; the real measured delta is recorded here.

_measurement_note: `measured` retains REAL historical wet vendor-BSP rootfs.tar measurements, byte-identical to ci/size-baseline.<board>.json. These are NOT full-firmware/mainline image measurements; no planning projection replaces them. Both boards require fresh wet builds after adoption. x86-minipc has no wet build yet, so it stays null.

orange-pi-5-plus.note: Real wet vendor-BSP production build (no --variant, no CERALIVE_BENCH_LABELS), measured by lib/measure-size.sh and read by orchestrate.sh's [6c/9] relative gate. MEASURED WITH armbian-firmware=26.8.1, and that is NO LONGER the committed pin: armbian-bsp-deb-versions.txt was promoted to 26.8.3 on 2026-08-26 because the Armbian archive keeps only the newest revision of that Architecture:all package and 26.8.1 had been purged from both the index and the pool. This measurement therefore PREDATES the current pin, and the 26.8.1 -> 26.8.3 firmware delta is NOT reflected in the figure below; re-measure on the next wet vendor-BSP build. The earlier 26.5.1 -> 26.8.1 promotion's +3,389,440 B firmware delta IS already inside it. Supersedes the 2026-08-02 / 67d053a baseline (1418792960); the change is that firmware bump plus the fonts-terminus removal (-460,800 B, A/B measured).
